purpose: cold complete business request with natural EOS; source of GLM-aligned response timing

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Follow the user instruction directly.
What is 2 + 2? Reply with only the digit.

generation_config_policy: explicitly override checkpoint generation_config do_sample=true and temperature=1.0
token_ids_status: not generated; exact target tokenizer required before GPU admission

acceptance.semantic_success: decoded final answer stripped of surrounding whitespace equals 4
acceptance.complete_business_success: semantic_success and natural EOS token ID 1 and finish_reason=stop; length/timeout/transport error are not complete success
acceptance.native_token_parity: separate boolean against same-B1 native reference; never inferred from semantic success
acceptance.event: correct_business_response_ns only when complete response received and complete_business_success is true

prompt_limit: target tokenizer must report at most 2016 input tokens; otherwise stop and revise preregistration before any formal attempt
